body:
On May 8th, Healthcare Compliance Pros will be launching a new reporting feature for Account Administrators. This new and improved report will provide a snapshot view of the compliance performance for your account. The report will outline training performance, utilization of compliance tools, assessment history, and an overview of your upcoming custom reminders. This report can be saved as a PDF and/or sent to specific employees via email at the frequency of your choosing.

To view this report, Account Admins may click the Account level and then notice that they have a new Dashboard tab that contains this new overview of your compliance program (See image below) . Click the REFRESH DATA button, and the most up to date information will be provided for you.

Again, this new report will be available to all HCP Account Administrators beginning May 8, 2017.
